Remark
[Trace, weak, and equality cases on surfaces] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0293 ↗ prop:chow-ii-surface-matrix-harnack ↗ prop:chow-ii-surface-trace-harnack-positive-curvature 1. ch15:15.11\group Surface Harnack Estimates

Tracing the surface matrix estimate gives the trace estimate. A flow defined only on $(0,T)$ satisfies the weak matrix inequality, and equality can occur for positively curved expanding gradient solitons limiting to a cone at time zero.
